epic.title: #634 — one spine per agent: frozen bookends, mutable middle
epic.intent_and_why: A run's plan should be frozen at its bookends and mutable in its middle, and live in one spine per agent, for Admiral, Commander and crew alike.

definition_of_done: amend() refuses to touch a declared bookend gate, while the middle stays freely mutable.
The three role spine templates this lane owns declare their bookends.
The plan change stays legible through amend's existing reason+authority+amendments trail.
A design comparison of N>=2 candidates is returned UNCONVERGED for the human.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Backward compatible: an undeclared plan behaves exactly as at 9b38b9d9.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Negative tests proven to go red first, plus independent reproduction in a fresh process against copies.
good_enough.appetite: One extended session, lane K of epic #567 wave 3.

hard_constraints: Never run a mutating engine verb against a live spine — copy first.
The engine under edit is not the engine in play (#269): validate in a fresh process with explicit paths.
File no issue (decision:no-issue-filing-mid-run); stage candidates only.
Do not touch lane J's files or map/INDEX.md.
fixed_decisions: decision:frozen-means-frozen — bookends stay fixed; only the middle is mutable.
decision:every-planning-role — Admiral, Commander and crew, not Commanders alone.
decision:design-it-twice — convergence between candidates is human-only.
decision:establish-from-child-first — settled by source read: from_child is a cross-agent verdict seam and survives untouched.

current_wave.objective: Close the closing-bookend gap in amend() and declare the bookends this lane owns.
exit_criteria: g1 and g2 integrated with independent APPROVE
full suite green in a clean detached worktree

completed_outcomes.outcome: Partial and honest. DELIVERED: amend() freezes a declared bookend gate against drop/rescope/retext-check and against an add landing past it, read through one swappable helper (_is_bookend), with 'bookend' added to rescope's overwritable tuple so a running spine can be frozen through the engine as a one-way latch; and the three role spine templates this lane owns (Commander, Admiral, Explorer) declare their bookends, pinned by an exact-set test. An undeclared plan is unchanged. NOT DELIVERED: the crew half of decision:every-planning-role, blocked on scripts/generate_spine.py which neither lane owns (see D0); and the 'capture the plan changed' half, which remains served only by amend's pre-existing amendments trail (see D2). NOT CONVERGED by design: the declaration form is returned as a comparison for the human, per decision:design-it-twice.
completed_outcomes.evidence: .agent-work/567-k/evidence/probe-closing-bookend.md (the measured gap); commit b0a96c3f; independent APPROVE at .agent-work/567-k/crew-handoffs/g1-review-result.md with a red-proof; .agent-work/567-k/DESIGN_COMPARISON.md; .agent-work/567-k/CRITIC_TRIAGE.md

discrepancies.signal: The crew half of decision:every-planning-role cannot be delivered by this lane: IMPLEMENTER_PLAN.template.json is not a *SPINE* template and is compiled by scripts/generate_spine.py, whose _compile_gate returns a fixed field list with no bookend key, so a hand-added declaration would silently vanish on regeneration.
discrepancies.evidence: scripts/generate_spine.py:669-684; the repo's own prior incident pinned at tests/test_generate_spine.py:1694-1700
discrepancies.reason: Reclassified by the Commander from blocks_current_wave_exit. It does NOT block this lane's exit — the lane delivers what it owns and floats the rest, which is the sanctioned move. What it invalidates is the DECOMPOSITION: the wave cut put decision:every-planning-role's crew half in lane K's scope, and it is not reachable from there, because generate_spine.py is in neither this lane's ownership nor lane J's fence. It needs an Admiral ruling on ownership, not a unilateral edit.
